key_insight: Nano- and micro-textures in perovskite solar cells do more than trap light: they also improve wetting, crystallinity, carrier extraction, and mechanical robustness.
engineering_relevance: For device engineers, textured interfaces offer a multi-functional route to boost efficiency and durability in perovskite photovoltaics and related optoelectronic devices.
method: Review of recently reported texture-enabled effects in perovskite-based solar cells
Synthesizes benefits beyond optics: wetting, crystallization, charge extraction, and flexibility
Connects texture design to broader performance gains in solar cells, photodetectors, and LEDs
evidence_signal: The paper is a review of recent studies, summarizing reported texture-related improvements rather than presenting new experimental data.
watch_item: Texture benefits may depend strongly on fabrication method and material stack, so gains in one device architecture may not transfer directly to another.
paper_title: More than just light management -- The multiple advantages of nano- and micro-textures in perovskite solar cells
